status: frozen 2026-11-06 for the 30-run pilot: environment checks passed for all 10 tasks, smoke run vsmoke-django-12050-jev-02 resolved, run_tests verified against a real container. Smoke runs used an earlier source hash and are not pilot results.
derived_from: internal-explore-v1 (coding_protocol.json); intervention, models, retrieval, selection and agent limits are unchanged
selection: First run uses the frozen 10-task pilot subset of the 50-task stratified sample in verified_sample.json, chosen from instance IDs and repository names only before any outcome.
intervention: Replace only the native explore subagent model response with Jev ranking deterministic file candidates. Writer, tools, issue, and budget stay fixed.
confidence_policy: Select three highest finite Noul relevance scores. This is a ranking experiment; no calibrated acceptance claim. On decision API or validation error, use the native explorer and charge both costs.

agent_testing.decision: Option (b), chosen 2026-11-06: the agent may run existing repository tests inside the task's official SWE-bench image via a run_tests wrapper.
agent_testing.mechanism: One container per run from the task image, network disabled, upstream git history replaced by a fresh single-commit repository. Before each run_tests call the workspace diff is applied to a clean /testbed, then the repository's standard test runner runs with the agent's targets passed as quoted arguments. The agent never sees the benchmark's test targets, test_patch or gold patch.

evaluation: Official swebench 5.0.2 harness on a local JSON copy of the pinned rows, one prediction per run, prebuilt images pulled from Docker Hub. Images are deleted after each task's conditions finish (replacement for the removed --cache_level option).
changes_from_v1: Dataset: SWE-bench Verified pinned sample instead of five pydicom Lite dev tasks.
Agent test command: run_tests <targets> inside the task container instead of host python3 -m pytest; prompt wording changes accordingly.
Evaluator: official Docker harness instead of local pytest.
Patch capture includes new files under the source roots (git intent-to-add); v1 captured tracked-file edits only.
Experiment budget cap: $10 for the 30-run pilot.
